title: Historic lighthouse in Occidental Mindoro undergoes restoration

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Government agencies and the municipal government of Lubang are pursuing conservation efforts to protect the historic Cabra Lighthouse at Cabra Island by cataloging and documenting artifacts and other objects found at the site. Members of the Joint Technical and Monitoring Committee (JTMC) recently participated in the lighthouse’s joint inventory and documentation for the historic site’s restoration and rehabilitation program. The Coast Guard District Southern Tagalog, a member of the monitoring team, said the activity aims to safeguard the lighthouse’s historical artifacts while supporting the continued preservation of the structure as an aid to navigation.
